transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I came because I don’t feel like myself. Like the warm part of me just kind of shut off. I’ll sit with my husband or try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort or even a little happy, but… there’s just nothing there.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About three weeks, I think. Since the accident at work… when that pallet collapsed and my coworker got hurt.
Are you still able to enjoy things you normally like to do?
Not really. I mean… I’ll sit with my husband or put on one of my shows after work, things that usually help, but it just feels blank. Like I know I should feel comfort or something good, and I don’t.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself or wishing you were dead?
I… no, I don’t think so. I haven’t been thinking about hurting myself.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge since the accident at work?
Yeah… especially near receiving. I keep looking at the racks and how high the pallets are, checking where the exits are, who’s behind me. It’s like I can’t really trust that it’s safe there.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say sad most of the day. It’s more like I’m just kind of shut down.
Have you noticed any change in your weight since you started feeling this way?
I haven’t really noticed. My clothes feel about the same, I think.
Have you been having trouble sleeping since the accident?
Yeah… most nights. I’ll be exhausted after the late shift, but when I’m about to fall asleep I kind of jerk awake, like I heard pallets moving. And even if I sleep, I don’t feel rested.
Have you been feeling guilty about the accident at work?
I don’t know… guilty? I mean, I keep going over it, but I’m not sure I’d call it guilt.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy and still find pleasure in now?

Not really. I’ll sit with my husband or put on one of my shows after work, and… I know it should feel comforting, or at least kind of nice. But it’s like that part of me is just shut off. There’s not much there.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in, even if it's just a little?

Honestly… not really. That’s part of why I came in. I’ll sit with my husband or put on my shows after work, and I know I should feel some comfort or… something. But it’s just kind of blank. Like that warm part of me shut off.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling like it's harder to get things done since you started feeling this way?

Yeah… I guess so. I’m not really doing my regular receiving work right now. I froze during a pallet move and then snapped at someone, and my supervisor took me off the floor. Said I wasn’t… safe like that.
Have you been feeling like you're worthless or a failure since the accident at work?
I don’t know… not really worthless. I feel embarrassed, I guess. Like I should be handling it better. But I don’t sit there thinking I’m a failure all the time.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since the accident?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really been checking, but my clothes feel about the same.
Do you feel depressed most of the day?
I don’t think I’d call it depressed most of the day. I’m… stressed and kind of worn out, but not depressed all day, no.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy and now find you can't even start or finish?

Yeah… kind of. It’s not that I can’t physically start something. I’ll sit with my husband, or put on one of my shows after work, and I know it’s supposed to feel nice or comforting… but it just doesn’t. It’s like that warm part of me just shut off.
Have you lost any weight since the accident at work?
Not that I’ve noticed. I haven’t really weighed myself or anything.
Have you lost any weight since the accident at work that you've actually noticed or had someone else mention to you?
No… I don’t think so. Nobody’s said anything to me about it, and I haven’t really noticed my clothes fitting different or anything.
Have you had anyone comment on your weight loss since the accident?
No… no one’s said anything like that to me.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight since the accident?
I don’t know. I haven’t weighed myself, so I couldn’t really say.
